chats.answer:
For LDAC wireless earbuds under $100, I'd prioritize sound quality, ANC (active noise cancellation), comfort, and app EQ.

My top picks are Soundcore Liberty 4 NC, EarFun Air Pro 4, and SoundPEATS Capsule3 Pro+. All support Sony's LDAC Bluetooth codec, which can deliver higher-bitrate audio than standard SBC or AAC on compatible devices.

One important detail: iPhones don't support LDAC, so you'll need a compatible Android phone or another LDAC transmitter to benefit from it.

Best picks, ranked

1. EarFun Air Pro 4

Best overall balance · ~$50–$80

LDAC, aptX Lossless, strong battery life, IPX5, wireless charging and good ANC. Especially versatile for Android users.

Official product page

2. Soundcore - by Anker Liberty 4 NC Noise Canceling True Wirel…

Best ANC and battery · $79.99

Excellent noise cancellation, nearly 10 hours measured with ANC on, wireless charging and customizable EQ. Default sound is bass-heavy.

View at Best Buy

3. SoundPEATS Capsule3 Pro+

Best sound quality · ~$80–$100

Hybrid xMEMS drivers, excellent clarity and 10-band EQ. Main weakness is shorter battery life, especially with ANC enabled.

4. CMF Buds 2 Plus

Best budget value · ~$59

LDAC, adaptive ANC, IP55 protection and excellent value. No wireless charging.

Prices are approximate U.S. listings and may vary. Recommendations informed by independent testing from SoundGuys (October 2026).

+1

For music sound quality, I'd lean toward the SoundPEATS Capsule3 Pro+. For everyday use, EarFun Air Pro 4 is the more balanced choice. If you frequently commute or fly, get the Liberty 4 NC.
